entities.name: Chott Ech Chergui
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Chott Ech Chergui is a large endorheic salt lake in Saïda Province, northwestern Algeria. It is located at 34.35°N 0.5°E in the level terrain of the Hautes Plaines region between the Tell Atlas and the Saharan Atlas and is one of the largest lakes in Algeria.
